title: Submodules of a finite module over a Noetherian ring are finite
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $M$ a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then every $A$-submodule $N\subseteq M$ is a finitely generated $A$-module.
